node_1.subject: Dolores Abernathy
node_1.description: This is Dolores Abernathy's plan for Monday February 13: wake up and complete the morning routine at 7:00am, walk to Hobbs Cafe by 8:00am, work at Hobbs Cafe from 8:00am to 4:00pm, go straight back to her room at the dorm and read from 4:00pm to 6:00pm, have dinner at the dorm at 6:00pm, read and work on the computer in her room from 6:00pm to 11:00pm, go to bed at 11:00pm.
